title: Salary rank within company
prompt: Using a CTE named emp_salaries that selects each employee's name and salary from the employees7 table, write a query that uses this CTE together with a window function to return name, salary, and salary_rank — where salary_rank is computed with RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC), so the highest salary gets rank 1 (ties share the same rank).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees7 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, salary INTEGER); INSERT INTO employees7 VALUES (1,'Ana',90000),(2,'Ben',90000),(3,'Cara',85000),(4,'Dev',80000),(5,'Ella',75000),(6,'Finn',70000);
reference_sql: WITH emp_salaries AS (SELECT name, salary FROM employees7) SELECT name, salary, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM emp_salaries;
